title: Seam every region plugs into
description: Contract is the interface every region imports and nothing else so they build in parallel.
body: The seam every region plugs into. Each of the sixteen regions is built against this file and nothing else — a region never imports another region's source, which is what lets them be built in parallel without growing into each other. Anything two regions need lives beside this file (STANDARDS.md §1.2).
